notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list places a tower here; it draws on the NC FFLA site, a Gary Weber list and 1:100,000 USGS topo maps, and may include observation towers. Smithfield is not in our NHLR or FFLOS data. Two searches and about four page reads found no source on build date, staffing, fires or fate. Search results for a Firetower Road in Smithfield (ZIP 27577) could not be read (HTTP 403) and are not used. The Smithfield Fire Department history page returned no tower text. The listed point is about 6.6 km east of the Wikipedia coordinates for the town (our calculation). Story is short because the evidence is short; verify before publishing as a lookout.
